about: Hi, I'm Sarang! I draw K-pop idols, ships, anime and video game characters. I am a traditional artist, but I color my pieces digitally on ibisPaint X.
I can draw your favorite K-pop ships or your OCs however you like (preferably TXT, ENHYPEN, &TEAM, SEVENTEEN and BOYNEXTDOOR).

faq.q: How long does a commission take?
faq.a: Usually 1–3 weeks, depending on the queue and the piece. Need it sooner? Rush is +40% if I can fit it in.
50% upfront and 50% before the final file. bKash / Nagad for local clients. International clients, just ask and we'll find what works.
Clear, well-lit photos (a couple of angles help), plus any outfit, pose or vibe notes. A screenshot of a pose you love is great too.

faq.q: Can I use the art as my pfp, or print it?
faq.a: Yes, for personal use! Please credit **@goguma_bee** when you post it. For merch, ads or anything you sell, ask me about a commercial licence first.

faq.q: Can I get the original pencil drawing?
faq.a: Sometimes! Ask in your DM and I'll let you know if shipping works for where you are.
Full refund before I start sketching, 50% after the sketch stage, and none once the final piece is delivered.
